title: Chapter 4: The 48-Hour Orbit (Stardate 49601.5)
summary: As Caelum-IV carries Sanctuary Bay through its 48-hour tidally locked orbit around Vespera, the family hits their first 16-hour Earth circadian wall while the orange sun Solis-V is still shining in Golden Dusk—and wakes up eight hours later at sunset to experience an entire waking day inside the luminous 24-hour Golden-Violet Ring-Night and the breathtaking 90-minute Umbral Hush eclipse.
